help.lead: Squeakposer is a fancy cheese factory: tunnels stacked on top, a nibble-roll for the chosen tunnel below. Burrow mode is the 14-hole snack grid.

pianoRoll.title: Nibble Roll
pianoRoll.body: Click empty to drop a crumb (it will squeak). Hold Shift for sharp cheddar or Alt for flat brie — it goes on a matching snack litter, summoned if needed. Sniff tool: drag empty space to grab a pile. Scratch tool: drag to paint a snack run. Chew tool: click to split a crumb. Drag crumbs to move; drag the right edge to make them longer. The thump lane under the roll is how hard you bonk the cheese.

arrange.title: Tunnels
arrange.body: Click a tunnel to pick it. Drag crumbs through time and pitch. Drag empty space to grab a pile.

playhead.title: Crumb-line
playhead.body: Drag the triangle (Squeakposer) or the yellow whisker (Burrow) to seek. Shift-click the ruler for tail-chase start, Alt-click for the end. Drag the yellow braces to resize the loop of doom.

convert.title: Turn MIDI into snacks
convert.body: On MIDI forage, pick Basic, Preserve, or Adapt ({esc} chickens out). Basic plops crumbs on the sheet. Preserve keeps the tune shape and stuffs pile-ups into Audio Racks. Adapt squishes the whole MIDI into Growtopia’s two-octave fridge. Repeats and long naps use Repeat Begin/End. Sharps and flats get their own litter. File → Add MIDI litters stacks more files onto the current feast.

worldTools.title: Burrow tools
worldTools.body: Sniff is the whisker: drag to look, tap a tile to pick it, drag a tile to scoot it, Shift-drag to grab a pile. Scratch paints a snack run. Chew splits a crumb where you click. Nibble is Burrow-only: stamp empty cells and right-click to yeet. Hold Shift or Alt while placing for cheddar/brie litters. Tail keeps the crumb-line in view. On a phone, two-finger drag pans. Also: cheese.

select.title: Grab crumbs
select.body: Drag empty space to grab a pile. Shift-click adds, ⌘/Ctrl-click toggles. Drag a grabbed crumb to move the whole horde. Arrows poke; Delete eats.

phone.title: Pocket rat
phone.body: Burrow stays up front with a bottom dock. Squeakposer tucks into a sheet. Tunnels and sky-cheese live in the panel button.

hover.title: Hover (Burrow)
hover.body: Shows the snack block, e.g. Sheet Music: Piano or Sheet Music: Flat Piano. Fancy.

panels.title: Panels
panels.body: Drag the grip between Tunnels and Nibble Roll. Minimize either from its header. Burrow’s side panel resizes from its left edge and can hide when you’re shy.

export.title: Smuggle
export.body: Stash keeps the feast in this browser. Stash as downloads a .notetopia only NoteTopia rats can open. Smuggle also offers GMSF for kixnoway.com, a Lua TXT blueprint, .gtmusic, MIDI, JSON, MP3, and WAV. Shh and only-me are respected on mixdown. GMSF columns pads empty holes at the end for extra cheese.

start.title: First nibble
start.lead: Burrow sheet, tools, scurry, and stash.

s1.title: Write on a sheet
s1.body: NoteTopia is a Growtopia snack sheet with an optional cheese factory. This tour pokes the real buttons. Reopen it from Squeak anytime.

s2.title: Squeakposer and Burrow
s2.body: Burrow is the 14-hole tile sheet. Squeakposer is the nibble-roll and tunnels. Tab swaps them like a confused rat in two rooms.

s3.title: The sheet
s3.body: This is the feast. Drag to look around. In Nibble, click empty tiles to drop crumbs, or right-click to yeet them.

s4.title: Tools
s4.body: Nibble stamps tiles. Sniff looks around and picks. Scratch paints a run. Chew splits a crumb. T cycles them. Squeak.

s5.title: Litters
s5.body: Each snack type is a litter. Pick one to place, or add another with + Litter / + Tunnel. MIDI litters land here too. More rats, more noise.

s6.title: Scurry
s6.body: Space scurries from the crumb-line. Shift+Space scurries from the stash hole. The time display is also the BPM (beats per mozzarella).

s7.title: Keep it
s7.body: Stash stores the feast in this browser. Smuggle can download a NoteTopia file, GMSF for kixnoway.com, MIDI, or a mix. Do not drop it in a sewer.

midi.title: MIDI and litters
midi.lead: Open a .mid, turn it into snacks, or stack more parts.

s1.title: Open a file
s1.body: Open a .mid / .midi to dump it onto the 14-hole sheet. .gtmusic and .GMSF drop in as Growtopia tiles. Foraging is legal here.

s2.title: Pick a convert
s2.body: Basic is literal. Preserve keeps the tune shape. Adapt squishes the mix into two octaves of fridge. You can change this later, you indecisive rat.

s3.title: Add MIDI litters
s3.body: Already have a feast? Add MIDI litters stacks more files as extra snacks instead of replacing the sheet. Pack rat energy.

s4.title: They become tiles
s4.body: Each imported part shows up as a litter you can place, shh, or smuggle. Pile-ups can become Audio Racks. Racks are just fancy cheese towers.

sheet.title: Sheet to Growtopia
sheet.lead: Build the grid, then smuggle GMSF.

s1.title: Stay on the grid
s1.body: Growtopia only hears what’s on this 14-hole sheet. Squeakposer is for editing; Burrow is what you copy in-game. Don’t freestyle off the cheese.

s2.title: Build the layout
s2.body: Use Nibble to stamp tiles. Sniff to move a group. Chew to split a long crumb. Hold Shift for cheddar, Alt for brie.

s3.title: One block per hole
s3.body: Two crumbs in the same hole need an Audio Rack. Pack to racks from Hoard if convert left a traffic jam on the sheet.

s4.title: Smuggle GMSF
s4.body: Export GMSF opens in kixnoway.com. GMSF columns pads empty holes at the end. .gtmusic is the older text format. Lua TXT is a NoteTopia blueprint. The rats voted.

phone.title: Pocket rat
phone.lead: Dock, drag to look, Squeakposer, and stash.

s1.title: Phones are different
s1.body: This walkthrough is for iPhone and Android rats. Burrow stays on the sheet. Drag with one finger to look around — same as Sniff on desktop.

s2.title: Bottom dock
s2.body: Sniff looks around and picks tiles. Nibble places and yeets them. Scurry sits in the middle. Squeak is the question mark. Tap the active tab again to hide the BPM cheese bar.

s3.title: Drag to look
s3.body: Sniff is the default on a phone. Drag empty space to move the view. Tap a tile to pick it. Switch to Nibble when you want to stamp snacks.

s4.title: Scurry
s4.body: The round button in the dock scurries and freezes. BPM and extra tools sit in the floating bar above the dock. Tap the active Sniff, Nibble, or Squeakposer tab to hide that bar; tap it or another tab to bring it back. Cheese.

s5.title: Squeakposer
s5.body: The piano button opens Tunnels. Drag empty space to pan, like Burrow. Shrink the tunnel list to icon + M/S if names are in the way of your crumbs.

s6.title: Keep it
s6.body: Stash stores the feast in this browser. New project wipes the sheet — you’ll be asked to stash a .notetopia or GMSF first if there are crumbs. Don’t ghost your own snacks.

welcome.heading: NoteTopia is free to use for planning music. Write in the browser, then see it as a Growtopia-style 14-hole sheet. Alpha, unofficial, not Ubisoft. Also: rats.
items: Burrow Mode: 14-hole pitch grid, place/yeet tiles, sky-cheese (sunny, stargazing, nothingness, solid color), tail-the-crumb-line, cramming, and zoom.
Burrow tools: Nibble, sniff, scratch, chew. Shift for cheddar, Alt for brie. Right-click yeets tiles.
Squeakposer: cheese-factory tunnels plus a nibble-roll, shh/only-me/loudness, stick, resizable or minimized panes.
Nibbles mode (sheet planner) and Lab mode (full factory + Burrow). Phone layout with Tunnels-first Squeakposer.
Snacks: piano, bass, drums, sax, flute, Spanish guitar, electric guitar, violin, lyre, trumpet, spooky, Winterfest — brie/cheddar where the game has them.
Audio Racks for stacked crumbs, accidental (cheddar/brie) litters, Repeat Begin/End packing.
Forage MIDI, .gtmusic, and .GMSF. Drag-and-drop. MIDI convert: Basic, Preserve, or Adapt. Add extra MIDI as litters on the current feast.
Smuggle a mix to MP3 or WAV (shh/only-me respected), plus .GMSF for kixnoway, .gtmusic, Lua blueprint, .notetopia, and MIDI out.
Other tunnels (G) ghosts crumbs from other snacks. Master loudness with a VU meter. Tail-chase region on the ruler.
Autostash in the browser, uneat/re-nibble, pocket/drop/select-all, Night Chorus demo on first launch.
Rat school, 20 serious languages plus Ratglish, Squeak (?), and shortcuts (Space scurry, Tab modes, arrows, Ctrl+Z/C/V/A).
wip: Adapt convert is still experimental — Basic and Preserve are the stable cheeses.
More phone polish, smarter MIDI convert, and extra convert options. Also more cheese, pending.
Source stays private for now — not open source yet. The rats signed an NDA.
A shorter custom domain if/when I grab one.
Whatever else people yell at me about on Discord. I am listening. I am small.

convert.body: Pick a convert method, then Convert. Trust the process. Fear the fridge.
convert.lockedHint: Not in this release. The rats said no.
convert.overlapHint: {count} overlapping tiles — Preserve packs these into Audio Racks.
convert.overlapHintSmart: {count} overlapping tiles — Adapt packs mixed snacks into Audio Racks and lowers the rack volume.
convert.longSheet: This file is longer than Growtopia’s {limit}-hole sheet. Turn on Squish to pack it.
convert.compressHint: Loop repeats and empty pauses with Repeat Begin/End. Very long sheets also pack tighter. Pack. Rat.
convert.fitKeyHint: Transpose to fit the two-octave fridge without jumping octaves.
convert.lowerHint: Move the melody lower on the fridge when it still fits.
convert.skipDrumsHint: Leave percussion tunnels out of the sheet. Less thump, more nibble.
convert.trimSilenceHint: Start the sheet at the first crumb instead of empty bars at the front.
convert.dropQuietHint: Ignore very soft MIDI hits so ghost crumbs don’t clutter the sheet.
convert.keyLockHint: Auto picks a chromatic shift that fits the two-octave fridge. None keeps the original key and folds octaves per part.
convert.spellingHint: How black keys are written onto Growtopia natural lines.
convert.splitAccidentalsHint: Put sharps and flats on their own snack litters. Off snaps everything to naturals.
convert.bellInstrumentHint: Where bells and music-box parts land.
convert.chordCapHint: Max crumbs kept on one tunnel in the same hole before racks.
convert.unisonHint: Keep the louder crumb when two hits share pitch and time.
convert.octaveDoublesHint: Keep one pitch class per hole when the same crumb is doubled in octaves.
convert.padThinHint: How hard to thin long overlapping chords.
convert.melodyIsolationHint: Keep lead, bass, and drums. Drop pads and extra harmony.
convert.packRacksHint: Turn colliding crumbs into an Audio Rack (up to five voices, one volume).
convert.mixRackVolumeHint: Set the rack wrench volume from MIDI velocity.
convert.duckRacksHint: Lower the whole rack when more voices are stacked. Too much cheese.
convert.maxRackVoicesHint: Growtopia racks cap at 5. Extra voices are dropped. Survival of the cheesiest.
convert.sameInstrumentChordsHint: Keep piano-on-piano chords as stacked tiles, or pack them into a rack.
convert.neverRacksHint: Resolve pile-ups by picking a winner instead of mixing. Brutal, honest, rat.
convert.compactKitHint: Share holes for hats, toms, and cymbals so the kit collides less.
convert.ghostHatVelocityHint: Hats softer than this are dropped.
convert.kickSnareHint: Drop hats on holes that already have a kick or snare.
convert.pickupTrimHint: Drop an incomplete first bar so the sheet starts on a downbeat.
convert.quietThresholdHint: MIDI velocities at or below this are dropped when Drop shy crumbs is on.
convert.graceHint: Tiny quiet ornaments: drop them, keep them, or attach them to the next crumb.
convert.targetLengthHint: Pack the sheet until it fits this many burrow holes.
convert.minBpmHint: Stop halving tempo once it would drop below this.
convert.mergeInstrumentsHint: Combine converted tunnels that share snack and accidental litter.
convert.normalizeHint: Scale the loudest crumb to 100 and the rest with it.
convert.flattenHint: Every sheet crumb plays at 100. Communism, but for notes.
convert.packingRacks: Packing {count} overlapping crumbs into Audio Racks…
convert.packingSheet: Packing the sheet… pack pack pack

v1.5-beta.label: Preserve
v1.5-beta.description: Keeps the original melody shape. Pile-ups become Audio Racks.

v1.label: Basic
v1.description: Converts the MIDI to something simple. Other snacks may overlap each other. Chaos cheese.

v3-experimental.label: Adapt
v3-experimental.description: Arranges the whole MIDI into two octaves. Mixed pile-ups become Audio Racks.
v3-experimental.hint: Adapt picks the real melody (usually piano, not a sax/clarinet double), keeps it in the singing register, and fits everything else into Growtopia's two-octave fridge. Mixed snacks pack into Audio Racks. Open Options for presets and per-tunnel control.

rack.title: Audio Rack
rack.placeHint: Up to 5 crumbs on one tile. A little cheese tower.
rack.help: Each crumb is 3 characters: snack (P piano, B bass, D drums, S sax, F flute, G guitar, V violin, L lyre, E electric, T trumpet), note A–G (lowercase = lower octave), then # cheddar, - natural, or b brie. Spaces are optional. Up to 5 crumbs play at once. The rats counted.

midiLayer.body: Pick a main snack for each file. Cheddar and brie crumbs become extra litters automatically — you don’t pick those variants here. The rats handle it.
midiLayer.extraLayers: Accidentals found ({kinds}) — extra litter(s) will be added.
midiLayer.noAccidentals: No cheddar or brie in this file. Boring, honest.
midiLayer.applyAll: Use this snack for every file
midiLayer.method: Uses your last convert method ({name}). Change it on a full MIDI forage.
